narr: Abundant monsoon moisture remained over the Four Corners region. This led to another round of showers and thunderstorms across southeast Utah. Storms were slow moving and produced heavy rain. A debris flow occurred on the Pack Creek Fire burn scar as a result of a large amount of heavy rain in a short period of time.
ev: Areas downstream of the Pack Creek Fire burn scar experienced flash flooding as a result of heavy rains over the fire. This included Sunny Acres Lane north of Spanish Valley, which had to close due to flooding.
